_registry: I-10-A a20260923-01 command registry (START_HERE 命令不能猜 two-stage binding). Entries carry binding_status: bound = argv verified against real code/tools and runnable; planned = contract frozen, argv will be confirmed after the referenced harness script exists and then flipped to bound BEFORE it runs. No entry runs from a production repo cwd; no git; no network.

exit_code_legend.0: pass — command ended normally AND the business judgement passed (outer runner 0 never overrides a child failure)
exit_code_legend.1: harness failure — the runner/script itself broke (import error, fixture error, missing expected file, unbound path)
exit_code_legend.2: no verdict / expected rejection — a negative case correctly refused on business grounds, or the command produces no verdict (read-only query)
exit_code_legend.3: not as expected — a positive case failed, a negative case was NOT refused, or a declared expectation did not hold (应红未红 / 应绿未绿)

batch_rc_semantics: this batch uses ONLY the frozen legend above; per-run raw rc is recorded verbatim and classified separately from the business verdict (commands.json expected_* vs run_log raw_rc)
